title: Determine singular Kronecker block determinant images (no new κ)
body:
PR #5250 leaves the determinant characters of singular minimal-index blocks and their multiplicity spaces open. This supplies a scoped written proof for `L_e(s,t) tensor I_r`, for every field and positive `e,r`, including all GL2 slice actions and the transposed orientation:

```text
Delta = {(x,y,z) in (K*)^3 : x^(e+1) y^e z^[r e(e+1)/2] = 1}.
```

The proof gives characteristic-safe polynomial-substitution lifts, the complete fixed-slice multiplicity stabilizer, and a constructive converse without root extraction. Over F_q, the GL orbit splits into exactly q-1 orbits under the product of the three special linear groups. This resolves the single-type part of the documented handoff; mixed indices/block types and arbitrary-tensor extraction remain open. No new kappa is claimed.

## Evidence and reproduction

- Independent literal stabilizer equations on eight fixed prime-field cases: **7,710 P,R pairs**, **4,470 stabilizers**, with exact determinant-image agreement. The oracle does not use symmetric powers or the predicted formula.
- **4,932 right-block lifts and 4,932 transposed lifts** across 13 explicit F2/F3/F4/F5 domains, including nonscalar multiplicity mixing. All GL2 actions and all nonzero multiplicity determinants in those domains are covered.
- **454 determinant triples** across both orientations: 154 explicit witnesses and 300 exclusions. Six mathematical mutation controls and fourteen malformed/domain controls pass. F4 exercises characteristic two with nontrivial determinants.
- Registered warning-strict normal/optimized commands, metadata/pins, committed-byte/source-history preflight and official export integrity pass at `81c0577b83cdafa73346da8ade1261b0b202e45f`.
- Read-only Git-free exported replay with empty executable PATH passes in both modes (2.193/2.146 seconds, CPython 3.12.14, macOS arm64). Scientific results match the registered run; all nine export files, including its manifest, retain their bytes and permissions. There are no external live scientific inputs.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/kronecker-determinant-image
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/kronecker-determinant-image --check-source-history
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/kronecker-determinant-image/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/kronecker-determinant-image/verify.py
```

Expected scientific marker: `PASS_KRONECKER_DETERMINANT_IMAGE`. `RESULT` gives full finite coverage and `PACKAGE_SHA256` binds package bytes. The official export SHA256 for the recorded environment is `daeb5c6faf2174eee5f0c0a030d737843b729f93f5d8e9602e73794bbaa942c1`; scientific equality is determined by the exact result and source bytes, not tar encoding alone.

## Contribution process and scope

Canonical main was pulled and refreshed again before publication at `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`, priority revision 7; the selected record remains kappa 0.00310045. The source-binding baseline passes. [Canonical investigation and advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5670), with a [short handoff-board pointer](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19188415), records the scope, bounded stop rule and five-point family comparison. Fresh targeted all-state PR searches and live Discussions found no competing successor in that coverage; this is not a global novelty claim.

The original `formal-interface-lemma` card is retained verbatim with **changed scope**: written mathematics and bounded corroboration, not Lean formalization or a selected-supplier implication. PR5250 is pinned at `43142bedc7cb5c0f1f73ff3fea6d9bfd237949ee`; its README blob equals the retained base version. Its archival merge and partially-reviewed ledger status are not treated as theorem acceptance.

Excluded: zero minimal index, unequal indices, mixtures of left/right blocks, regular/singular coupling, and regular pencils with no invertible rational slice. The verifier has explicit small domains; arbitrary dimensions rely on the written proof. Native realization, dirty-state ownership, routing, storage, precision, compiler cost and the full recursive invoice remain unknown. No physical supplier, selected-frontier edit, complete multiplication theorem, Lean build or selected cold replay is supplied. Human and proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Hosted CI status is separate from the completed local checks.

## Credit and next questions

Nick Petalas retains credit for PR5250 and this explicit handoff. David Ganz retains atlas A030/A026/A029 and its cited lineage. Kronecker blocks, symmetric powers and the regular-pencil canonical-form/centralizer work remain classical predecessors; no global literature priority is claimed. Prepared by **apoursh**, with substantial **OpenAI Codex** assistance including parallel proof, overlap and independently implemented oracle checks. Apache-2.0; exact source pins and attribution are retained.

Two concrete next questions remain in README/TASK: start mixed singular blocks with `L_1 direct sum L_2`, and treat regular `diag(s,t,s+t)` over F2 where every rational slice is singular. Neither scope is reserved.

Only eight files in `research/kronecker-determinant-image/` are added. Shared code, frozen predecessor packages and selected-frontier files have no changes.
